# ============================================================================
# Sound Creations Ltd - security + performance
# File: /public_html/.htaccess (domain root)
# Updated: 2026-10-19 (supersedes 2026-09-28)
#
# NOTES FOR FUTURE EDITORS:
#  - Do NOT edit inside the BEGIN/END WordPress, BEGIN/END seraphinite or the
#    cPanel PHP handler markers. They are regenerated automatically and your
#    changes will be lost.
#  - Security headers below are scoped to STATIC FILES ONLY. PHP pages already
#    get them from the theme (soundcreations/inc/hardening.php). Do not add
#    them globally here or every page will send them twice.
#  - XML-RPC is already disabled in PHP, so it is not repeated here.
#  - /sitenew/ and /testimonials-v-N/ redirects live in PHP
#    (sound-creations-core/includes/post-types.php) and only fire on a 404,
#    so real content always wins. Do not duplicate them here.
#  - The master copy of this file is docs/server/htaccess-root.txt in the
#    repository. Change it there first, then paste it here.
#
# CHANGES ON 2026-10-19:
#  - HTTPS runs before the legacy redirects: an old http://.../newwebsite/
#    link now takes one 301 hop instead of two.
#  - Removed ExpiresDefault "1 month". It was also applied to dynamic JSON
#    and XML (REST API, admin-ajax, sitemaps, feeds), so browsers could keep
#    stale data for a month. Every cached type is now listed explicitly and
#    dynamic types are set to 0 seconds.
#  - Images: 180 days and no "immutable". Theme images and replaced media
#    keep the same filename with no version string, so a one-year immutable
#    cache would hide an updated photo from returning visitors.
#    CSS, JS and fonts keep one year + immutable, because they are versioned.
#  - Added AVIF, TTF/OTF, PDF, JSON-LD, web manifest and favicon handling.
#  - Added Brotli where available (gzip stays as the fallback).
#  - Added WordPress's documented wp-includes / wp-admin/includes blocks.
#  - Added more sensitive-file patterns (composer/npm files, archives,
#    wp-config backups).
#  - Added UTF-8 charset for text assets.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Canonical HTTPS, then legacy /newwebsite/ redirects.
#    HTTPS first, so an old http:// link costs one hop, not two.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On

# Canonical HTTPS. The second condition keeps this safe behind a proxy or CDN
# (without it, some hosts loop forever).
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
RewriteCond %{HTTP:X-Forwarded-Proto} !=https
RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

# The site moved from /newwebsite/ to the domain root. Preserves Google
# rankings and keeps old inbound links alive. Query strings are kept.
RewriteRule ^newwebsite/?$ / [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^newwebsite/(.+)$ /$1 [R=301,L]

# WordPress hardening (from the WordPress "Hardening WordPress" guide):
# block direct requests to internal PHP files that are only meant to be
# included by WordPress itself.
RewriteRule ^wp-admin/includes/ - [F,L]
RewriteRule !^wp-includes/ - [S=3]
RewriteRule ^wp-includes/[^/]+\.php$ - [F,L]
RewriteRule ^wp-includes/js/tinymce/langs/.+\.php - [F,L]
RewriteRule ^wp-includes/theme-compat/ - [F,L]
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compression. Already active on this server; kept as a safety net so
#    compression survives a plugin being disabled. The server skips anything
#    that already carries a Content-Encoding, so this cannot double-compress.
#    WOFF/WOFF2, JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and MP4 are already compressed and
#    are deliberately not listed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_brotli.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType BROTLI_COMPRESS text/html text/plain text/xml text/css
  AddOutputFilterByType BROTLI_COMPRESS text/javascript application/javascript application/x-javascript
  AddOutputFilterByType BROTLI_COMPRESS application/json application/ld+json application/xml
  AddOutputFilterByType BROTLI_COMPRESS application/rss+xml application/atom+xml
  AddOutputFilterByType BROTLI_COMPRESS application/manifest+json image/svg+xml image/x-icon
  AddOutputFilterByType BROTLI_COMPRESS font/ttf font/otf application/vnd.ms-fontobject
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/plain text/xml text/css
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/javascript application/javascript application/x-javascript
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/json application/ld+json application/xml
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/rss+xml application/atom+xml
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE application/manifest+json image/svg+xml image/x-icon
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE font/ttf font/otf application/vnd.ms-fontobject
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Browser caching.
#    CSS/JS/fonts: 1 year. Safe because the theme cache-busts automatically
#    using the filemtime of main.css, and WordPress core/plugins add ?ver=.
#    Images: 180 days, not immutable (unversioned filenames, see top).
#    Video and PDFs: shorter, because they get replaced in place.
#    Dynamic responses (HTML, JSON, XML, feeds): never cached by the browser;
#    page caching is seraphinite's job.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_expires.c>
  ExpiresActive On

  ExpiresByType text/css                       "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/javascript         "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType text/javascript                "access plus 1 year"

  ExpiresByType font/woff2                     "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType font/woff                      "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/font-woff2         "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType font/ttf                       "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType font/otf                       "access plus 1 year"

  ExpiresByType image/jpeg                     "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/png                      "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/gif                      "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/webp                     "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/avif                     "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/svg+xml                  "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/x-icon                   "access plus 180 days"
  ExpiresByType image/vnd.microsoft.icon       "access plus 180 days"

  # Shorter on purpose: the hero video is due to be re-encoded and re-uploaded
  # over the same filename. Raise this once the video is final.
  ExpiresByType video/mp4                      "access plus 1 month"

  # The company profile and FANE catalogue PDFs get replaced in place.
  ExpiresByType application/pdf                "access plus 1 week"

  ExpiresByType application/manifest+json      "access plus 1 week"

  # Dynamic content: never cache in the browser.
  ExpiresByType text/html                      "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType application/json               "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType application/ld+json            "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType application/xml                "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType text/xml                       "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType application/rss+xml            "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType application/atom+xml           "access plus 0 seconds"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  <FilesMatch "\.(css|js|woff|woff2|ttf|otf)$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
  </FilesMatch>

  <FilesMatch "\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif|svg|ico)$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=15552000"
  </FilesMatch>

  <FilesMatch "\.mp4$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=2592000"
  </FilesMatch>

  <FilesMatch "\.pdf$">
    Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=604800"
  </FilesMatch>

  # Cookies are pointless on static files and block some proxy caches.
  <FilesMatch "\.(css|js|jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif|svg|ico|woff|woff2|ttf|otf|mp4|pdf)$">
    Header unset Set-Cookie
  </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

# Validators that work on shared/load-balanced hosting (inode-free).
FileETag MTime Size

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Security headers for STATIC ASSETS ONLY.
#    PHP pages already receive these from the theme - see note at top.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  <FilesMatch "\.(css|js|jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif|svg|ico|woff|woff2|ttf|otf|mp4|pdf)$">
    Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
    Header set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
  </FilesMatch>

  # SVGs can carry script. Served directly (not as <img>), they must not run it.
  <FilesMatch "\.svg$">
    Header set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:"
  </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. File protection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Options -Indexes
ServerSignature Off

# WordPress config, server files, install notes and logs.
<FilesMatch "^(wp-config\.php|wp-config-sample\.php|\.htaccess|\.htpasswd|\.user\.ini|php\.ini|readme\.html|license\.txt|debug\.log|error_log)$">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>

# Developer and package-manager files that should never be on a live server.
<FilesMatch "^(composer\.(json|lock)|package(-lock)?\.json|yarn\.lock|phpunit\.xml(\.dist)?|Gruntfile\.js|gulpfile\.js)$">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>

# Backups, dumps, logs, shell scripts and archive copies of the site.
<FilesMatch "\.(bak|backup|old|orig|save|swp|swo|dist|sql|sql\.gz|log|ini|sh|tar|tgz|tar\.gz)$">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>

# Copies of wp-config left behind by editors (wp-config.php.bak, ~ files).
<FilesMatch "^wp-config.*$">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>

# Hidden files (.git, .env), but keep .well-known working for SSL renewal.
RedirectMatch 404 /\.(?!well-known)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Correct MIME types and charset, so the caching and compression rules
#    above match.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_mime.c>
  AddType image/webp                 .webp
  AddType image/avif                 .avif
  AddType image/svg+xml              .svg .svgz
  AddType image/x-icon               .ico
  AddType font/woff2                 .woff2
  AddType font/woff                  .woff
  AddType font/ttf                   .ttf
  AddType font/otf                   .otf
  AddType video/mp4                  .mp4
  AddType application/manifest+json  .webmanifest
  AddType application/x-web-app-manifest+json .webapp

  AddDefaultCharset utf-8
  AddCharset utf-8 .css .js .json .xml .svg .webmanifest .txt
</IfModule>

# BEGIN WordPress
# The directives (lines) between "BEGIN WordPress" and "END WordPress" are
# dynamically generated, and should only be modified via WordPress filters.
# Any changes to the directives between these markers will be overwritten.
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]
RewriteBase /
RewriteRule ^index\.php$ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule . /index.php [L]
</IfModule>

# END WordPress
# BEGIN seraphinite-accelerator
# The directives (lines) between "BEGIN seraphinite-accelerator" and "END seraphinite-accelerator" are
# dynamically generated, and should only be modified via WordPress filters.
# Any changes to the directives between these markers will be overwritten.

# END seraphinite-accelerator

# php -- BEGIN cPanel-generated handler, do not edit
# Set the “ea-php80” package as the default “PHP” programming language.
<IfModule mime_module>
  AddHandler application/x-httpd-ea-php80___lsphp .php .php8 .phtml
</IfModule>
# php -- END cPanel-generated handler, do not edit
